extracts_match_manifest.what: Every committed NCCS extract has the sha256 and row count MANIFEST.json records (CP2).

llm_cache_intact.what:
Every cached LLM response matches its stored hashes. This does not show that a script's
    prompts still hit the cache: CP4's run_cp4.py --replay misses since f825052 (the example spec
    in every prompt changed), and CP5 replays are checked by a1_unseen_replays.

cp4_verdicts_follow.what:
Each CP4 theory's verdict and family q-values recomputed from its stored p-values and
    effects (scripts/review_theory_runs.py), and they match the committed review.json.

outcome_tails.what: CP4 finding: T2, T3, T5 outcomes are heavy-tailed (SD > 600x robust SD); T1, T4 are not (< 2x).

sweep_cells.what:
Main sweep (rerun in CP5 under the outcome rule): 28 cells; a cell whose H1 and H2 effects are both under the floor must be
    unsupported, and none is above it.

sweep_rule_before_after.detail: 14 unclipped cells identical to CP4; 14 clipped
sweep_rule_before_after.what:
CP5 sweep rerun under the outcome rule: the cells the rule did not clip have exactly
    their CP4 effects (the rule leaves them alone), and only heavy-tailed outcomes were clipped.

outcome_rule.detail: 5 clipped, 4 still above 3; fundraising share exempt
outcome_rule.what:
CP5 outcome rule (docs/validator.md 2.8): bounded [0, 1] outcomes are exempt (D-a); an outcome
    is clipped once at the pooled 1st/99th percentiles when SD > 3x robust SD (D-b); after one clip
    4 outcomes stay above 3 and are logged, not clipped again (D-c).

heavy_tail_controls.detail: 2 heavy-tail controls recovered only with the rule (H1 -0.253, +0.274 SD)
heavy_tail_controls.what:
CP5 V2 (CP4 feedback F4): a 0.25 SD effect planted raw in operating margin and in liabilities
    to assets is supported with the rule, unsupported without it, and the unplanted version is
    unsupported.

heavy_tail_placebos.detail: 2 outcomes x 8 placebos: 0 false positives; planted control survives
heavy_tail_placebos.what:
CP5 V6: on both heavy-tailed outcomes, 0 of 8 placebos is called anything but unsupported
    after the family correction, and the planted 0.25 SD control survives it.

cp5_reruns_follow.what:
CP5 V4: T1-T5 rerun under the rule; each verdict and family q follows from the stored
    numbers, and T1/T4 (outcomes the rule does not clip) keep their CP4 effects.

a1_unseen.what:
CP5 O3: A1 on the 40 unseen benchmark texts, first pass. The rate is recomputed from the
    rows, and the committed cache replays every row with no API call.

a1_unseen_replays.what: The committed LLM cache reproduces every A1 row offline (measure_assumption1_benchmark --replay).

benchmark_metrics.detail: plan validity 17/20, control recovery 5/5, false positives 0/3; literature 9/9 run unsupported
benchmark_metrics.what:
CP5 benchmark (first pass, 2387c33): the three metrics recomputed from the per-entry table,
    run errors, plan failures and gold reviews in benchmark_cp5.json. A run error or a plan that
    disagrees with gold is an invalid plan; a positive control counts only if supported AND on
    gold; a negative control that did not run is left out of the false-positive rate.

benchmark_review.detail: 17 entries follow, each in its own family
benchmark_review.what:
CP5 V7: every benchmark verdict and family q recomputed from its stored numbers, every
    entry judged in its own BH family (literature or controls), matching the committed review.json.

benchmark_postfix.detail: plan validity 20/20, control recovery 5/5, false positives 0/5; literature 10/10 run unsupported; 17 first-pass effects unchanged
benchmark_postfix.what:
CP5 benchmark after the population fix (benchmark_cp5_postfix.json): metrics recomputed the same
    way, every verdict follows in its own family, and the 17 entries that ran in the first pass have
    exactly their first-pass effects (the fix only changes specs that crashed).
